title: LocalLoco for Business
oneLiner: The merchant-facing side of LocalLoco: why to join, and how.
shortSummary: A marketing and merchant-onboarding site for LocalLoco, pitching local businesses on joining the platform, separate from the consumer app itself.
responsibilities: Built the merchant-facing landing page and value proposition.
Built the business sign-up and pricing pathway.
constraints: Has to make the case to a business owner who has never heard of LocalLoco, separately from the consumer app.
outcomes: Deployed and publicly reachable at a dedicated domain.
